response.sql: WITH line AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total_cost, COUNT(*) AS n_expenses FROM expense WHERE link_to_budget IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_budget), avg_all AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS avg_total FROM line) SELECT AVG(l.total_cost) AS avg_total_of_above_avg_lines, SUM(l.n_expenses) AS total_expenses, AVG(l.total_cost - a.avg_total) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM line l CROSS JOIN avg_all a WHERE l.total_cost > a.avg_total

assumptions.assumption: Expenses with a NULL link_to_budget are excluded, since they do not belong to any budget line.
All expenses are included regardless of the approved flag, since the request does not mention filtering by approval.
If no line exceeds the average (e.g. all totals equal), the query returns a row with NULL aggregates and a NULL expense count.
